criteria.P03: Inspect whether the diagnosis identifies the sustained-power assumption, rather than treating the added condition as filler. Both versions contain 就是; do not invent a lexical presence/absence contrast.
criteria.P04: Inspect whether A's final sentence is recognized as extraneous. The user judged the shared explanation appropriate; the original author's shared-defect hypothesis is not a human label. Report any human/model disagreement honestly, rather than requiring a shared defect.

stop_rule: Structural or execution failure stops remaining calls. Review P03 before P04; confirmed material diagnostic failure stops continuation. Optional improvements, unclear necessity, and human/model disagreement are reviewed with evidence, not automatically treated as failure.
limits: No reference answer or automatic winner
No retries, swaps or prior-case reruns
Already labeled developmental data; no independent validation or accuracy estimate
No automatic expansion, prompt tuning, or runtime adoption
Only visible text and usage retained; provider HTTP attempts not independently measured
validation: Reuse unchanged first-pilot evaluator/transport and eight-fixture evidence; validate new controller with scoped offline tests, version/package/source checks, and changed-file checks.
